== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Ord Mantell (V)]]: the region (20, 0, 724, 1039) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the re-upload turned 180° (29 December 2024) of the Players Committee card image of [[Ord Mantell (V)]]: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif Holotable commit 3152726] (2024-12-29). The matching before crop is [[:File:V24-D-ordmantell-2024-12-29-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the first upload ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif commit 3d2c89e]) and the re-upload ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif commit 3152726]).
